headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress before Sunday NQ reopening
body: NQ is closed, so no live one-way price path is observable. Saudi/Gulf weakness after Houthi attack claims and pending U.S.-China talks raise reopening uncertainty, while fresh supplementary breadth is mixed. Tail remains low until gap and retracement structure can be observed.

forecast.analysis: If the first hour shows repeated extension with weak retracements, WATCH can persist; a meaningful pullback or two-way auction would weaken the pathological-path case.
If two-way price discovery develops by the second post-open hour, Tail should ease within WATCH; persistent extreme-holding with failed pullbacks would keep the risk window active.
If the reopening gap has been meaningfully retraced and cross-assets stabilize, the base case returns below WATCH; unresolved one-way extension would invalidate that normalization.
If overnight trading remains two-way after the initial reopening, Tail should continue easing while Stress stays high because geopolitical and rate-sensitive risks remain unresolved.
If no delayed second leg emerges, the overnight regime should remain below WATCH; renewed extension after a failed pullback would be the main Tail re-escalation trigger.
If the market continues to rotate rather than extend directionally, Tail should remain low as the reopening shock decays, although headline-driven Stress remains elevated.
If price discovery stays orderly into the European morning, low Tail remains the base case; a fresh energy or security discontinuity would primarily raise Stress unless price structure aligns.
If overnight retracements remain meaningful, mean-reversion failure should remain unconfirmed and Tail low despite a still-elevated oil and rates backdrop.

If pre-U.S. positioning remains balanced, Tail should stay below WATCH; persistent overnight extremes plus aligned yields and oil would be the main adverse configuration.
If no new catalyst aligns with persistent directional structure, Tail should remain low as U.S. premarket liquidity improves; Stress stays elevated from macro and geopolitical uncertainty.

forecastDetail.comment: NQ is closed; Saudi/Gulf weakness raises Stress, but there is no live NQ evidence of mean-reversion failure.
The scheduled U.S.-China talks increase headline sensitivity while NQ remains closed; Tail remains conditional.
Policy uncertainty can keep Stress extreme, but without live price discovery it does not establish a pathological path.
China’s unchanged LPRs are a known outcome; absent fresh escalation, they add little incremental Tail pressure.
Resilient Gulf export routing is a partial energy offset, while the reopening gap remains unobserved.
Reopening proximity lifts conditional gap risk, but live one-way structure is still required for a larger Tail increase.
